rows.claim: POST /api/marketplace/v3/orders/meta is the batch read source for FBS metadata and metaDetails
legacy meta was scheduled for removal on 2026-04-30; new work must use metaDetails
WB exposes checking, checked, error and unchecked operator states and continues timed-out validation after delivery
supplierStatus is new, confirm, complete or cancel; sgtin mutation is limited to confirm
reconciliation must preserve every metaDetails entry and raw decision for key sgtin
PUT sgtin accepts 1 to 100 codes of 16 to 135 characters and returns 204 on success
DELETE by key removes all values for the metadata key and is unsafe for single-code automatic repair
deliver can return 409 MetaValidationFail; its evidence is a transition result, not a substitute for a complete read snapshot
metadata reads are split into seller-scoped batches of at most 100 unique order IDs
read/delete limit is 300 per minute, 200 ms interval and burst 20; 429 pauses the read run without mutation
missing response rows are classified as REMOTE_MISSING and never inferred as an empty metadata set
pending and unchecked results remain time-stamped nonfinal facts; stale snapshots cannot unlock dispatch
scope and batching are isolated by tenant and seller; conflicts require data-owner approval
full KIZ values are excluded from general logs and evidence; reports use masks and fingerprints
large runs are resumable, seller-scoped, rate-limited and read-only by default; emergency mode does not weaken boundaries
current sync collapses metaDetails by kind, visits local rows only and cannot safely serve as historical reconciliation
WB validation is not proof or mutation authority for the legal code state in Chestny ZNAK
FBS sandbox exists for later contract tests; no sandbox or live call was made in S03
BLG-I09 is a narrow existing external-contract and data-integrity change, not a new module or operator UX
these domains are unchanged; only their local KIZ ownership must not be mutated by reconciliation without a later contract
official sources describe polling metaDetails; no relevant FBS metadata webhook was identified
